- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1753 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The LAST RUN DIFF intended to change `[ -d .codex-workflow-src ]` to `[ -e .codex-workflow-src/.git ]`, but the file still carries the old guard.
  WHY IT FAILS AT RUNTIME: In a consumer repo whose `.codex-workflow-src` is a plain directory (staged from a release, no `.git`), the poller calls `git -C .codex-workflow-src rev-parse HEAD`, which walks up to the consumer's own git checkout and returns the consumer's HEAD. The engine SHA changes every time the consumer pushes a commit. On every poll tick, the engine SHA differs from the one recorded when the security pass failed, so `SECURITY_PASS_AUTO_RESET` fires and re-runs the full-range audit, resetting the fix-cycle budget each time. The project never completes.
